title: Winged Warrior vs Shadow Beast
description: A dark fantasy scene featuring a winged male warrior with white feathered wings and dark horns, wielding a sword against a massive black spiky shadow creature with glowing white eyes and a jagged smile. The creature is surrounded by swirling blue and orange flames while three translucent fiery female spirits float around the chaotic battle. A stone table with glowing blue potions and bottles sits in the right foreground under a blood-red moon and dark night sky.
prompt: A dramatic dark fantasy battle scene at night, a horned male warrior with large white feathered wings and dark clothing fights with a sword against a giant black spiky orb-like shadow monster with huge glowing white eyes and a jagged grin. Three translucent fiery female spirits with flowing hair swirl around them in blue and orange flames.
